sights.w: Hokkaido's largest aquarium (about 250 species) on the Shukutsu headland — seals and sea lions in pens sectioned off from the open sea.
A rare 'moor' hot spring of plant-derived organic water, prized as a skin-softening bath, on the Tokachi River just outside Obihiro.

sights.n: Naitai Highland Ranch & Naitai Terrace (ナイタイ高原牧場)
sights.address: Naitai, Kamishihoro, Katō District, Hokkaido, Japan
sights.w: Japan's largest public ranch (est. 1972) rolling over Mount Naitai at the north-west edge of the Tokachi Plain — the terrace café looks out across the plain.

sights.address: Erimo, Horoizumi District, Hokkaido, Japan (Hidaka coast, south of Tokachi)
sights.w: Where the Hidaka mountains run into the Pacific as a chain of reefs — a wind-blasted cape at the southern tip of the Hidaka range.
